ko.theme_title: 속보: 붕어빵계 '식량 자원' 선포! 인류, 달콤한 배신에 눈물
ko.theme_desc: 붕어빵, 드디어 인간을 배신하고 '단팥 지배 시대' 선언! 멸종 위기 인류, 붕어빵의 달콤한 유혹에 속절없이 무너져…

scenarios.10y: 10년 후: 붕어빵 챌린지 망해서, '좋아요' 대신 '단팥'으로 연명하는 인플루언서. 붕어빵 여왕에게 굽신거리며 붕어빵 먹방 라이브하다가 정체성 혼란 겪음. '나, 지금 뭐 하는 거지?'
scenarios.20y: 20년 후: '단팥 저항군'에 가입해 붕어빵 계략 파헤치려다, 붕어빵 여왕의 '핵인싸' 붕어빵 맛집 홍보대사로 발탁! 딜레마에 빠져 '좋아요' 대신 '단팥'을 외치며, 붕어빵 광고에 진심이 되어버림. '이게 뭔...'
scenarios.30y: 30년 후: 붕어빵 여왕, 알고 보니 '미슐랭 붕어빵' 개발을 위한 위대한 계획의 선구자! 인플루언서는 붕어빵 홍보대사로 '글로벌 붕어빵 앰버서더'가 되어, 붕어빵을 전 세계에 알리며 '단팥 제국'의 문화 전도사가 됨! 해피엔딩!

en.theme_title: Breaking: Fish-Shaped Bread Declares 'Food Resource' Status! Humanity Weeps at Sweet Betrayal
en.theme_desc: Bungeoppang, the beloved Korean fish-shaped pastry, has turned on humanity, announcing the 'Age of Red Bean Domination'! The endangered human race crumbles under the sweet temptation of Bungeoppang...

scenarios.10y: 10 Years Later: Our influencer is struggling to adapt to the 'Great Bean Paste Uprising,' trading likes for bean paste rations. They're reduced to begging the Queen of Fish-Shaped Bread for content, hosting sad mukbang livestreams and questioning their life choices. 'Is this... my brand?'
scenarios.20y: 20 Years Later: They join the 'Resistance,' only to be recruited as the Queen's *official* spokesperson for the hottest fish-shaped bread restaurants! Torn between their old life and the bean paste overlords, they're now enthusiastically promoting fish-shaped bread, screaming 'bean paste!' for the 'gram. 'What has my life become?'
scenarios.30y: 30 Years Later: Turns out the Queen's plan was actually genius! She was developing Michelin-star fish-shaped bread, and our influencer, now a 'Global Fish-Shaped Bread Ambassador,' is celebrating fish-shaped bread all over the world! They're now a cultural icon of the 'Bean Paste Empire!' Happy ending!
